# Repository map

*Generated by the repository map in A-Viable-Fork/Repo-Infrastructure's kit from the files git sees, their Role headers and `repo-map-manifest.json`. Do not edit by hand; the kit's `repomap` check fails when it is stale.*

## 1. Directories

| Directory | Holds |
|---|---|
| `.` | A typed map of mathematical transformations across eight domains, with its fill layer, audit, receipts, formal links and Lean project. |
| `.github` | GitHub configuration. |
| `.github/workflows` | Continuous integration. |
| `.infra` | Part of the vendored kit, pinned by infra.lock.json (Repo-Infrastructure). |
| `.infra/checks` | Part of the vendored kit, pinned by infra.lock.json (Repo-Infrastructure). |
| `.infra/lib` | Part of the vendored kit, pinned by infra.lock.json (Repo-Infrastructure). |
| `.infra/templates` | Part of the vendored kit, pinned by infra.lock.json (Repo-Infrastructure). |
| `.infra/tools` | Part of the vendored kit, pinned by infra.lock.json (Repo-Infrastructure). |
| `audit` | The audit: the fixed random sample, its field-by-field grades, and the targeted grades. |
| `audit/blind` | The blind second reading of the Mathlib match grades: the packet, the answer key, and each reader's grades. |
| `audit/strict` | The strict second reading of the fill review: the blind sample and its packet, the strict reader's grades, and the targeted sweep. |
| `catalogue` | The paper catalogue: every paper the map cites and how deeply it has been read. |
| `catalogue/imports` | Paper lists imported from sibling repositories, bibliographic fields and reading status only. |
| `docs` | Notes about the map that are neither data nor generated. |
| `docs/inbound` | Dated proposals from other repositories and sessions, to verify and then fold in or decline. |
| `domains` | The map, readable, one file per domain (generated by scripts/build.mjs). |
| `excerpts` | Verbatim windows that receipt claims, each with its source URL and the hash of the source as fetched. |
| `generation` | Generation rounds: what was commissioned, what generators returned (landed verbatim and hashed), and how it was graded. |
| `generation/2026-10-11-deform-001` | The DEFORM-001 round: theory change read as Lie algebra deformation; the kinematical calibration and the Poincare-Heisenberg seed, computed exactly and graded. |
| `generation/2026-10-11-gen-001` | The GEN-001 round: the first test of gap-driven generation, its candidates and composites, graded. |
| `generation/2026-10-11-history-001` | The HISTORY-001 round: whether the deformation generator retrodicts paradigm transitions, pre-registered, with null controls and a time-sliced vocabulary. |
| `generation/2026-10-11-mm-dr-001` | The MM-DR-001 round: D9 operations and effect invariants from three generators, graded. |
| `generation/2026-10-11-mm-dr-002` | The MM-DR-002 round: D9 bound to Android at android-16.0.0_r4 by three generators, graded against the tagged source. |
| `generation/2026-10-11-mm-dr-003` | The MM-DR-003 round: prior art for D9 and its Android binding from two generators, graded against the cited repositories. |
| `generation/2026-10-11-mm-dr-004` | The MM-DR-004 round: D9 bound to NixOS at nixpkgs 7c8764b, and the desktop vocabulary measurement, graded against the pinned source. |
| `generation/2026-10-11-mm-dr-004/part-b` | The three graders' claim tables for Part B, every fact cited by path and line at the pins; model output, sampled and re-read in grading-part-b.md. |
| `generation/2026-10-11-ro-bp-001` | The RO-BP-001 round: two D9 operations for journal-native systems, written for the Research_OS blueprint, graded and ruled. |
| `generation/2026-10-12-select-001` | The SELECT-001 round: whether the conflicts of physics select the historical successor from menus large enough to fail, pre-registered. |
| `generation/2026-10-12-select-002` | The SELECT-002 round: the mixing form F5 tested with decoys on every menu, and iterated menus following the lowest-order path under conflicts in order, pre-registered. |
| `generation/2026-10-23-poly-001` | The POLY-001 round: entries for the operations inside the polynomial ring (degree, coefficients, evaluation, derivative, roots and the rest), the questions fixed by Research_OS's Mathlib decomposition, graded against Mathlib at the pin and pre-registered. |
| `generation/2026-10-23-un-001` | The UN-001 round: the logged effect tested in two shapes (D9-X40 landed), a host restyling a guest, a principal's lifecycle, and the per-UID firewall binding, from the Unattested inbound notes. |
| `lean` | A Lean 4 project on the pinned Mathlib that states and proves claims Mathlib does not cover. |
| `lean/MathMap` | The Lean sources, one file per topic, each naming the entries it bears on. |
| `mapfill` | The fill layer the parser applies over the landed map: clone resolution, fills, additions, conditions, corrections, invariants and formal links. |
| `prompts` | Research prompts sent out to generate candidate content; returned reports are leads, verified before anything lands. |
| `reports` | Generated reports on data quality, error rates, the catalogue and the formal queue. |
| `scripts` | The parser, query tool, checks, build and tool server. Node, no dependencies. |
| `source` | The map as landed, verbatim, and the report its D7 names come from. |
